The '''Ruhnuk Mining Disaster''', also known as the '''Catastrophe on Ruhnuk''', was an event on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ruhnuk]] that had a significant impact on [[Gatressa Mining Conglomerate]] operations and led to extensive navigation interference and unreliable communication caused by a lingering storm.<ref name="CatastropheOnRuhnuk" />

==Prelude==
Initially successful in extracting [[Calcite/Legends|calcite]] and [[derillium]], mining operations later experienced a significant decline in output and was reduced to well below expectations due to the primary sources were mostly used and [[Mining/Legends|mining]] output redirected towards infrastructure construction on the planet's surface. The situation was made worse by the arrival of an unusual [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] surrounding around the planet.<ref name="CatastropheOnRuhnuk" />

==The disaster==
The arrival of an unexpected nebula triggered dust storms and energy disruptions, causing communication interference. As a result, the [[Construction droid/Legends|construction droids]] lost connection to the master control systems. The workers on the ground suffered heavy losses, and those who survived found themselves in a hostile environment.<ref name="CatastropheOnRuhnuk" />

Despite the chaos, Project Overseer [[Fent Jucalla]] prioritized evacuating the surviving workers, ensuring their safety during the disaster. Although it resulted in abandonment of equipment and tremendous losses of investment, efforts were focused on rescuing workers on Ruhnuk.<ref name="CatastropheOnRuhnuk" />

==Aftermath==
Records from trade hubs indicated that [[Ore/Legends|ore]] shipments from Ruhnuk ceased following the disaster. The powerful ionic storm continued to cover the planet and its surroundings.<ref name="Ruhnuk" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Ruhnuk Mining Disaster was first mentioned in the [[2022]] Game Update 7.2 of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'', the eighth digital expansion to the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TORweb">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20221111|text=Game Update 7.2 "Showdown on Ruhnuk" Livestream Recap}}</ref>
